墨梅图（墨梅图（第22页）人群渐渐朝于知晚聚集，赵玉燕和楚青霜走到孟婵玥身旁。楚青霜先开口问道：“方才国师当众拉着你走，我们俩都很担心，你没事吧？”“我没事。”孟婵玥轻轻摇了摇头，目光扫过两人，反问道：“你们俩呢？”楚青霜挑了挑眉，指尖漫不经心地拂过鬓边的碎发，语气里带着几分嘲弄：“方才有几位世家公子凑上来没话找话，我嫌烦，直接把藏在袖口里的毒蝎露了个边，他们脸都白了，立马躲得远远的，我的耳根子一下子就清净了。”边上的赵玉燕忍不住轻轻咳了一声，脸颊泛着点浅粉，声音压得低低的：“我觉得仲世子人不错，与他聊了一会儿，他把自己画的梅花送我了。”“仲世子？”孟婵玥闻言有些好奇：“你是说仲太傅的嫡孙仲唯行？”赵玉燕点点头，抬起指尖往梅林边上的方向指了指，孟婵玥顺着她指的方向望过去，就看见一位穿月白锦袍的清俊少年，正拨开梅花枝往这边偷偷看，视线撞上孟婵玥的目光时，又慌慌张张地别过脸。孟婵玥勾了勾嘴唇，刚要同赵玉燕说话，身后的梅枝忽然传来一阵轻响，一道身姿挺拔的身影穿过错落的红梅，朝她走近。她回过头，看到于伯远手里攥着一个画轴停在他面前。“于世子？”孟婵玥疑惑地眨了眨眼睛。“三公主。”于伯远看着孟婵玥，将手里的画轴递了过去。“这幅墨梅图，送给你。”“送给我？”孟婵玥没有动，站在她身后的赵玉燕和楚青霜相视一眼，忍不住勾起嘴角。“三公主，这幅墨梅图是我专为你所画，你在我心中，就如这幅墨梅，自有一番傲骨。”于伯远将画轴又往前递了递，朗声开口。此话一出，孟婵玥猛地抬眼，眼底闪过异色。她没有想到，不过才见了一面，自己在这位于世子心中竟然有这么高的评价。“多谢于世子。”孟婵玥双手接过于伯远手里的画轴，眉间的冷意淡了几分。于伯远见此，心中雀跃不已，面上更为庄重。他压低声音，说道：“三公主，国师此人并非良配，你可别被他那张脸迷惑了……”话音落下，他后退一步，朝孟婵玥行了一礼，转身离开。孟婵玥看着他挺拔的背影，稍显凌乱的脚步，整个人顿在原地。站在她身后的楚青霜忍不住笑起来：“婵玥，这位于世子看起来端方正直，没想到竟然会说国师的坏话。”“他就差说自己才是婵玥的良配了！”赵玉燕捂着嘴笑起来。赏梅宴结束后，昭武帝收到了许多请求赐婚的奏折，其中被提名最多的是南梁三公主孟婵玥。国师庄拓和于太保都写了奏折，国师求娶孟婵玥，于太保也给自己的儿子于伯远求娶孟婵玥。

Mo Mei Tu (Mo Mei Tu (Page 22)) The crowd gradually gathered towards Yu Zhiwan. Zhao Yuyan and Chu Qingshuang walked to Meng Chanyue. Chu Qingshuang asked first: "Just now, the Imperial Master pulled you away in public. We were both very worried. Are you okay?" "I'm okay." Meng Chanyue shook her head gently, glanced at the two of them, and asked: "Where are you two?" Chu Qingshuang raised her eyebrows, her fingertips careless. Carefully brushing the broken hair on the temples, there was a hint of mockery in her tone: "Just now, a few young masters from aristocratic families came up to talk to each other. I was annoyed, so I exposed the poisonous scorpion hidden in the sleeves. Their faces turned pale and they immediately hid far away. My ears were clear all of a sudden." Zhao Yuyan beside her couldn't help coughing lightly, her cheeks were a little pink, and her voice was low: "I think Prince Zhong was a nice person. After chatting with him for a while, he gave me the plum blossom he painted. "Prince Zhong?" Meng Chanyue was curious when she heard this: "You mean Zhong Taifu's grandson Zhong Weixing?" Yuyan nodded, raised her fingertips and pointed in the direction of the plum forest. Meng Chanyue looked in the direction she pointed, and saw a handsome young man wearing a moon-white brocade robe, parting the plum blossom branches. Looking secretly, when her eyes met Meng Chanyue's, she turned away in panic. Meng Chanyue curled her lips and was about to talk to Zhao Yuyan when a soft sound suddenly came from the plum branches behind her. The tall and straight figure walked towards her through the scattered red plums. She turned around and saw Yu Boyuan holding a scroll in his hand and stopping in front of him. "Prince Yu?" Meng Chanyue blinked in confusion. "Third Princess." Yu Boyuan looked at Meng Chanyue and handed over the painting scroll in his hand. "This painting of plum blossoms is for you." "Give it to me?" Meng Chanyue did not move. Zhao Yuyan and Chu Qingshuang, who were standing behind her, looked at each other and couldn't help but raise their lips. "Third princess, I painted this painting of plum blossoms just for you. You are as proud as this painting of plum blossoms in my heart." She handed it forward and spoke loudly. As soon as she said this, Meng Chanyue raised her eyes suddenly, and a strange look flashed in her eyes. She didn't expect that she would have such a high opinion of this prince just after seeing him. "Thank you, prince." Meng Chanyue took the scroll in Bo Yuan's hand, and the coldness between her eyebrows became lighter. In a low voice, he said: "Third Princess, the Imperial Master is not a good match. Don't be fooled by his face..." After saying this, he took a step back, bowed to Meng Chanyue, and turned to leave. Meng Chanyue looked at his upright back, slightly messy steps, and stood still. Chu Qingshuang, who was standing behind her, couldn't help laughing: "Chanyue, this prince looks upright. Thinking that he would say bad things about the Imperial Master, he almost said that he is a good match for Chan Yue!" Zhao Yuyan covered her mouth and laughed. After the plum blossom appreciation banquet, Emperor Zhaowu received many petitions for marriage. Among them, Meng Chanyue, the third princess of Nanliang, was the most nominated. Both Zhuang Tuo and Yu Taibao wrote memorials. The state counselor asked to marry Meng Chanyue, and Yu Taibao also asked for his son Yu Boyuan to marry Meng Chanyue.
